name: Yadorishi Otome no Chikai to Mahou
original_name: 宿りし乙女の誓いと魔法
source:
After fixing up a stuffed toy he comes across in a park, the protagonist Shinomiya Hibiki, get caught up in a strange event.

Like receiving gratitude in folk tales.

Hibiki gains a glittering, mysterious mark—— A magic symbol. The light from the symbol gradually envelops him, transforming him into a magical girl.

"......What's going on, what's this......"

While at a complete lost and unable to grasp the situation, before Hibiki, a girl appears.

"I must protect you." 

Led by the girl who claims to be a magical girl as well, Hibiki arrives at a Western-styled manor called "Otogi-kan," which severs as a dormitory for students at the prestigious Aether Girls' Academy, a gathering place for magical girls. 

An extraordinary combination of cross-dressing and magic—— The story of these captive maidens is about to change.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/31.otochika/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
修理好毛绒玩具后，他在公园里遇到了主角四宫响，并陷入了一个奇怪的事件。

就像民间故事中的感恩一样。

响获得了一个闪闪发光的神秘印记——魔法符号。符号发出的光芒逐渐将他包围，将他变成了魔法少女。

“……这是怎么回事，这是什么……”

就在完全迷失、无法掌握情况的时候，响的面前出现了一个女孩。

“我必须保护你。” 

在自称魔法少女的少女的带领下，响来到了一座名为“乙木馆”的西式庄园，这里是魔法少女聚集地、久负盛名的以太女子学园的学生宿舍。

变装与魔法的非凡结合——这些被俘虏的少女的故事即将发生变化。

[翻译编辑自[url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/31.otochika/#story]官网[/url]]
